notes: "Work can be divided by pages, or passed from content drafting to visual refinement. A handoff needs page IDs, the task and evidence-preservation constraints. Different-page saves can proceed independently. A same-page or shared-metadata conflict requires rereading and reconciling the intended change. Activity distinguishes client reports from saved receipts; configuration alone is not online presence. The diagram illustrates task allocation. In a separate controlled test, native DeepSeek Harness and ChatGPT saved distinct pages from the same starting state. A stale same-page proposal was rejected; after rereading, a focused font and color handoff succeeded. Claude Code did not participate in this round’s parallel test. See evidence/collaboration.json."
